text:
Ana: Quick thread — finalizing topic shortlist for the Apr 18 webinar. Goal: show pragmatic cost/latency tradeoffs for real apps. Need 3 short demos + 1 customer case. Thoughts?
Kevin: Love that. Suggested themes: Practical inference economics; Serving under budget constraints; Productionizing open models.
Maria: leaning into 'inference economics' + customer case. We should highlight Hosted vs Dedicated decision points.
Ana: @Sam can you ping potential speakers? Need 1 engineer demo, 1 product narrative, 1 customer.
Sam: reached out to Jen (infra), Oliver (runtime), Priya (Acme customer). Jen confirmed, Oliver tentative, Priya asked for a short brief.
Jen: I can demo batching + KV cache. 7–10 min live demo. Will need a 30m rehearsal.
Kevin: Rehearsal windows — propose 4/15 10:00 PT and 4/16 15:00 PT. Which works?
Maria: 4/16 15:00 PT works for me. :thumbsup:
Ana: Draft run order: intro 5m, customer case 8m, demo 1 (Jen) 10m, demo 2 (Oliver) 10m, panel + q&a 20m. Optional breakout deep-dive 20m after main session.
Sam: yep, breakout for eng deep-dive after main.
Ana: Lead capture plan: registration form + feature-interest checkboxes; route leads by interest tag to sales/SDR flows. Who owns the form?
Kevin: @Maria can you own asset + CDP tagging?
Maria: Yes — will prepare tags and nurture paths.
Ana: @Oliver can you prep 2 benchmark slides (latency vs cost per 1k tokens) comparing Hosted vs Dedicated using 8k context examples? Include test config.
Oliver: Can do. Will export screenshots + a small config snippet. Example config I'll include: ```json
{"model":"redwood-13b-quant","seq_len":8192,"batch":8,"gpu":"A100"}
```
Jen: Also request captions + transcript. @ops-bot can you confirm captioning in US & EU?
ops-bot: Caption service available in us-west-2 and eu-west-1 for scheduled events.
Ana: Fallback: pre-record 2–3 minute demo clips for every live demo and upload to S3. If live demo fails, we swap to pre-recorded.
Sam: Checklist items: mic check 30m prior, test demo endpoint 20m prior, confirm swap protocol (5m decision window).
Kevin: Add a slide that transparently shows cost per 1k tokens. We want actionable takeaways.
Maria: Audience routing — prioritize PMs + infra leads. We'll segment follow-ups: product orgs get playbooks; infra gets technical notes and eval harness.
Ana: Abstracts due EOD Tue. Paste 2–3 sentence blurb + one-line speaker bio here when ready.
Jen: Abstract: "How caching and adaptive batching cut token costs in production — live demo and tips for safe rollouts." Bio: "Jen — Principal Infra Engineer, focuses on inference runtime optimizations."
Oliver: Abstract: "Choosing model variants and quantization for predictable latency at scale." Bio: "Oliver — Runtime Lead, benchmarks and kernel tuning."
Priya: I'll confirm the customer case blurb by Wed morning.
Sam: Once abstracts in, I'll send calendar invites for rehearsals and green-room slots.
Ana: @Kevin you'll own slide deck review and final narrative.
Kevin: On it — will review slides 4/14 and give edits.
Ana: Thanks all. Tiny ops note — ensure recording retention is set to 6 months for replay and gated access.
Maria: I'll set retention and gating.
Jen: :raised_hands: Ready to slot in demo.
Ana: Awesome — pushing to finalize speaker order tomorrow. :rocket:
